basic_details.job_title: UTCPS Accountant Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.department: Department of Social Welfare, Chandigarh Administration

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated to eligible candidates

age_limit.details: The age limit for the Accountant Officer post is 25 to 62 years.

qualification.details: 2 years’ experience as Accounts Officer or Section Officer (applicable for candidates applying through the B.Com. route).

salary_details.accountant officer: Rs. 36,370/- per month (equivalent to DC Rate of Finance Officer Accounts)

selection_process: The selection process comprises an interview. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the eligible candidates.
how_to_apply: Download the application form available at the Department of Social Welfare website (https://chdsw.gov.in) or Chandigarh Administration website (www.chandigarh.gov.in).
Fill in the required details in the application form accurately.
Paste one recent passport-size photograph on the application letter.
Attach self-attested photocopies of testimonials of essential qualification, experience, and resume.
Ensure the application is signed and complete in all respects.
Send the complete application by post or hand delivery to the O/o Member Secretary, UTCPS, Sector 19-B (Opposite House No. -1042), Chandigarh on or before 27.10.2026 by 3:00 pm.
important_instructions: The walk-in-interview published on 06.10.2026 stands cancelled; fresh applications must be submitted. Applications will be summarily rejected if a candidate makes more than one application for a particular category/post. Applications will be rejected if the applicant does not mention the name of the post applied for. Unsigned or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of one year. The Competent Authority reserves the right to cancel the selection process at any time and at any stage without assigning any reason thereof. Date and time of the interview will be intimated only to eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q1. What is UTCPS Accountant Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UTCPS Accountant Officer Recruitment 2026 is a notification issued by the Union Territory Child Protection Society to fill 1 vacancy for the Accountant Officer post on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UTCPS Accountant Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Accountant Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UTCPS Accountant Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application is 27.10.2026 by 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for UTCPS Accountant Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired as an Accounts Officer or Section Officer, OR hold a B.Com. degree from a recognized university with 60% marks and ability to work on accounting software, MS Office, and Internet with ease.

faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the Accountant Officer post is 25 to 62 years.
